cost:
cost: key
	| prices calls totalCents |
	prices := state at: 'prices' ifAbsent: [ Dictionary new ].
	calls := state at: 'calls' ifAbsent: [ #() ].
	totalCents := 0.
	calls do: [ :c |
		(c at: 'key') = key ifTrue: [
			totalCents := totalCents
				+ ((c at: 'tokens') * (prices at: (c at: 'model') ifAbsent: [ 0 ]) / 1000) ] ].
	^ (totalCents rounded) / 100.0
set_price:
set_price: model cents_per_1k_tokens: cents
	(state at: 'prices' ifAbsentPut: [ Dictionary new ]) at: model put: cents.
	^ cents
check_key:
check_key: key
	((key isString) and: [ key notEmpty ])
		ifFalse: [ self error: 'key must be a non-empty string' ].
	^ key
check_model:
check_model: model
	((model isString) and: [ model notEmpty ])
		ifFalse: [ self error: 'model must be a non-empty string' ].
	^ model
top_spender:
top_spender
	| calls best bestCost |
	calls := state at: 'calls' ifAbsent: [ #() ].
	best := nil.
	bestCost := 0.
	(calls collect: [ :c | c at: 'key' ]) asSortedCollection do: [ :k |
		| c |
		c := self cost: k.
		(best isNil or: [ c > bestCost ])
			ifTrue: [ best := k. bestCost := c ] ].
	^ best
usage:
usage: key
	| calls |
	calls := state at: 'calls' ifAbsent: [ #() ].
	^ (calls select: [ :c | (c at: 'key') = key ])
		inject: 0
		into: [ :sum :c | sum + (c at: 'tokens') ]
record_usage:
record_usage: key model: model tokens: tokens
	| limits limit count |
	self check_key: key.
	self check_model: model.
	count := self check_token_count: tokens.
	limits := state at: 'quotas' ifAbsent: [ Dictionary new ].
	limit := limits at: key ifAbsent: [ nil ].
	limit ifNotNil: [
		(self usage: key) + count > limit
			ifTrue: [ self error: 'token quota exceeded for key ', key ] ].
	(state at: 'calls' ifAbsentPut: [ OrderedCollection new ])
		add: (Dictionary new
			at: 'key' put: key;
			at: 'model' put: model;
			at: 'tokens' put: count;
			yourself).
	^ self usage: key
check_token_count:
check_token_count: tokens
	((tokens isNumber) and: [ tokens > 0 and: [ tokens rounded = tokens ] ])
		ifFalse: [ self error: 'tokens must be a positive whole number' ].
	^ tokens rounded
set_quota:
set_quota: key tokens: limit
	self check_key: key.
	self check_token_count: limit.
	(self usage: key) > limit ifTrue: [ self error: 'quota already exceeded' ].
	(state at: 'quotas' ifAbsentPut: [ Dictionary new ]) at: key put: limit.
	^ limit
